set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM fit public hypothesis API. W3 in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro needs to pass a named semantic response expression into FirstLevelEstimateRequest without reconstructing basis IDs, response weights or metadata in the application. The ordinary StructuralHypothesisDsl.NamedT/NamedF currently expose only compile(schema), while selected EstimateOutput.Contrast takes the canonical StructuralTContrast. Their existing lowering is private. Related completed contracts: bd-01KZ3ZHSXGGBY1C8HAQRX2RR39 and bd-01KZ3ZHT9WGCP16GY9BHHV3QXA; no open native work covers this small interop gap.

Expose a checked toStructural conversion on named semantic T and F hypotheses, and have existing compile use that same conversion. Preserve IDs/descriptions, selector/run/modulator/basis semantics, response functionals/units, exact discretization and typed lowering failures. Keep unnamed expressions noncompilable and avoid new application-specific branches or numerical algebra.

Acceptance: a public named response expression converts into a selected-estimate request with its full functional identity, both direct and canonical compilation remain equivalent, F composition and failure behavior remain intact, JVM/Scala.js fit tests and a compiled guide example pass. Qualify exact source and relevant PLS Neuro authoring consumer before admission. This is a public API improvement and W3 prerequisite; it does not claim W3 UI or saved-output completion, or authorize publication.
set.title: Expose canonical structural forms of named semantic hypotheses
